description_short: The Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Smart Cities and Communities (SMACCs) is accepting applications for September 2027 entry. Applicants seeking Erasmus Mundus or other scholarships must apply by 1 February 2027 and are told their status by May 2027; cohorts are capped at 40 students.
